jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Technical (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Affinidi is a technology company dedicated to changing data ownership for good. We empower businesses and individuals with control and ownership of their data, with a comprehensive approach to managing their holistic identity – accounting for all aspects of their digital footprint while ensuring privacy and security.

Affinidi’s technology enables users to benefit from decentralised digital identity solutions. We believe that everyone has the right to own and control their data, and we are committed to creating a trusted digital credentials ecosystem that empowers businesses and individuals to securely exchange data and services across borders and industries.

 

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager (Technical) who wants to help define how trust is built into the next generation of AI systems. At Affinidi, we’re building the Trust Fabric product suite to give AI agents verifiable identity, policy guardrails, and real-time observability, so organisations can move from promising proofs of concept to secure, governed production deployments with confidence. 

This is a role for builders. You’ll work side by side with engineering to turn ambitious ideas into real, high-impact products, fast, iteratively, and with strong product judgment. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous challenges that don’t come with a playbook, bring structure to what matters, and help the team move with clarity, speed, and conviction. You’ll also collaborate with deeply engaged teams and senior leaders in an environment that expects high standards, values ownership, and gives you the chance to shape meaningful products from the ground up. 

If you like combining technical depth, product thinking, and execution, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Shape and deliver solutions: Partner closely with engineers to define and refine solutions early, helping move ideas from concept to production in practical, incremental steps while staying close enough to implementation to understand trade-offs and guide decisions. 
  • Drive focused, outcome-oriented delivery: Balance user needs, market context, and execution speed while focusing on getting working solutions into users’ hands for validation, then iterate based on feedback and measurable outcomes. 
  • Work through ambiguity: Take ownership of areas where requirements are not fully defined, structure problems into clear, actionable paths forward, and maintain momentum even as direction continues to evolve. 
  • Own product direction: Contribute to product strategy and roadmap definition, align short-term priorities with longer-term platform thinking, and make thoughtful trade-offs that support both delivery and scalability. 
  • Collaborate across stakeholders: Work across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams, engage effectively with senior and executive stakeholders, and bring alignment and clarity in environments with diverse perspectives. 
  • Be developer-obsessed: Understand developer workflows and key pain points, and help improve integration, usability, and the overall product experience.

jobs.description:
Position description 

 Sonar is looking for passionate Product Managers who will make our products truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for SonarQube Cloud, SonarQube Server, and SonarQube for IDE. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in the field of Code Quality. 

 

 As a Product Manager, you will shape our code quality offering, ensuring that our users write more reliable and maintainable code and have a seamless experience in the product. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of developers, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our products, from very high-level features down to technical aspects of the analysis processing. 

 

 You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help development teams write better and more secure code.  Job Description Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders? 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

 What you will be do: 
 Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.

 Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
 Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
 Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
 Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
 Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
 Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
 Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Prolific for AI

Team: Product, Research & Design

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The Role

As we scale our AI Product Group, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take founder-level ownership of the tooling that lets frontier AI model developers conduct cutting-edge research on Prolific. Increasingly, our AI customers are among the leading AI companies in the world, and this role will additionally lead a team of client-facing engineers dedicated to building strategic integrations and rapid, bespoke development for their most demanding needs. You'll report into the AI Lead, and join a brilliant team of Product Managers building next-generation AI tooling within our AI Product Group.

Impact: You'll be the Product person accountable for the outcomes of a stream-aligned team building next-gen tooling for frontier AI model developers, and also prioritise for impact the work of a client-facing engineering team. This is a career-defining moment to shape how some of the world's biggest technology companies build AI – no big deal. You'll own how our most strategic AI clients experience Prolific end to end, from product to bespoke integration.

Experience: You'll bring experience building AI native systems, with particular experience building AI native UX. You'll have had success taking complex human workflows and distilling them into highly adaptable technical systems, then scaling access to those systems across multiple interaction surfaces – UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs. You'll also have experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and know how to turn a sophisticated client's bespoke needs into a scalable integration rather than a one-off fix.

Domain: You will manage two teams which together give you unmatched closeness and opportunity to build tools for the companies and researchers driving the AI frontier. The Data Collection Tooling team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that enable high-quality human data collection for AI training and evaluation. Additionally the strategic integrations team interfaces directly with our biggest AI accounts for custom builds. jobs.description:
About BJAK 
 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
  
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
  
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
  
 This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.
  
 What you'll be doing 
 Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation. 
  

 What you'll need 
 Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

 Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.
  

 Outcomes 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap 

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch 

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds 

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted 

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

jobs.title: Product Manager, Delivery Promise
jobs.description:
About Wolt 

 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

 We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

 The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt. 

 As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

 Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

 Our humble expectations 

 You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

 
 Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 

 It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts. 

 Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.

 High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.

 Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.

 Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.

 Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

 
 The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

 The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

 
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data and API
jobs.description:
About Climatiq
 If you’re looking for a role that has an impact on the world, and not just a balance sheet, Climatiq is the place for you.
 We're a fast-growing startup embedding carbon intelligence into business decisions worldwide. Our platform—combining the world's leading emissions database with sophisticated AI and calculation tools—helps thousands of sustainability teams work faster and reduce emissions across corporate and product carbon footprints.
 Our team is united by fighting climate change. We value both speed and quality because the crisis demands we move fast without cutting corners. That requires trust, clear communication, and everyone delivering excellent work.
 Our HQ is in Berlin, and we have a remote-friendly team across Europe. We are supported by world-renowned investors including Alstin Capital, Singular, Cherry Ventures and more, and we’re a certified B Corp.
  
 Job Description:
 As a Product Manager, you’ll be joining a team of experienced engineers, scientists, and GTM professionals building high-impact features for some of the largest organizations around the world.
 You will lead product development of our Data and API solutions and manage roadmap + delivery to drive growth and customer adoption. Both Data and API are foundational to Climatiq’s product portfolio, which includes our AI solutions, Data Studio and PCF solutions.
 You’ll report to the CEO and partner with the CTO and product and engineering leads to bridge product and technology, working alongside a cross-functional team of data engineers, climate scientists, and carbon accounting experts to drive innovation and execution. This role goes beyond feature builds. Your work will empower thousands of enterprises to measure, report, and act on emissions effortlessly.
 If you're passionate about leveraging cutting-edge technology to accelerate climate action, we want to hear from you.
 
 Responsibilities:
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Data and API solutions, in close collaboration with founders, engineering, and commercial teams

 Lead strategic product initiatives from concept to launch—identifying market opportunities, building business cases, and defining success metrics

 Partner with LCA and carbon accounting experts on methodology development and data quality to ensure emission calculations remain accurate, compliant, and trusted

 Build relationships with customers and strategic platform partners to gather feedback and validate product ideas, using those insights to inform prioritization and iteration

 Monitor product performance and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement

 
 Qualifications:
 4-6 years of experience in a PM role in B2B SaaS/PaaS with a high level of ownership, preferably in a fast-paced startup environment

 Experience with managing API products and data integration tools is a major plus

 Proven track record of shipping innovative software products from concept and discovery through launch and iteration

 Strong product sense and technical skills, with the ability to understand complex data-focused products and to work closely with engineering teams

 Demonstrated user/customer empathy in working with B2B customers, including communicating roadmaps and supporting pre- and post-sales work where necessary

 Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment and make effective decisions with incomplete information

 Excellent written and oral communication skills, with experience in preparing and delivering high-impact presentations to internal and external stakeholders

 Strong curiosity for all things tech and genuine interest in the climate tech sector, sustainability, and a carbon-neutral economy

 
 Additional Information
 Location: Berlin 

 Starting date: As soon as possible

 Hours: Full-time, flexible working hours

 Compensation: Competitive salary and benefits, including employee stock options, learning and development stipend, regular team offsites, and more

 As a certified B Corp, Climatiq is an equal-opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply for roles on our team. Send us your CV and a short cover letter, highlighting your skills and experience, relevant for the advertised role.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing Platform
jobs.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
 
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Product Manager, joining our Product team in the Fintech vertical. As a Billing Platform Product Manager, you will be a key member of our triad of product managers in the billing team, each leading their independent teams yet working within an interconnected scope.

Als Teil unseres lokalen Product Marketing Teams handelst Du wie ein CEO für Deinen Bereich: Du entwickelst die Go-to-Market-Strategie in Deutschland weiter und bist verantwortlich für deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung. Dein Hauptziel ist es, durch innovative Marktstrategien die Ziele für ongeboardete Praxen zu erreichen und die Zufriedenheit unserer Nutzer weiter zu erhöhen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und setzt Go-to-Market-Strategien für Doctolib’s Produkt- und Feature-Launches um
  • Als Stimme unserer Nutzer verbesserst Du kontinuierlich unseren Product-Market-Fit und gestaltest unsere Product Roadmap

  • Du analysierst Markttrends und die Wettbewerbslandschaft, um strategische Chancen zu identifizieren
  • Du definierst die Produktpositionierung und -botschaften für den deutschen Markt
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams Marketing, Sales, Customer Success sowie Product & Tech zusammen
  • Du managst Feature Releases und stellst deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung sicher
  • Gemeinsam mit anderen Teams verfolgst du regulatorische und technische Rahmenbedingungen und arbeitest mit daran, ein Umfeld für kunden- und nutzerfreundliche Lösungen zu schaffen

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit: 

  • Du hast mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise als Manager:in im Product Marketing oder Go-To-Market Strategie, oder mit einem Hintergrund in der Top-Tier-Managementberatung oder VC - kombiniert mit Product Management Erfahrung
  • Du hast eine ausgeprägt strukturierte und analytische Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Du hast bereits eng mit Tech & Product Teams gearbeitet
  • Es fällt Dir leicht, Prioritäten zu setzen, Ressourcen sinnvoll zu allokieren und Projekte strukturiert zu führen, um Go-to-Market Strategien effektiv zu entwickeln und umzusetzen.
  • Du bist erfahren im Management seniorer Stakeholder (VP, MD, Executive Committee)
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Ideen klar und überzeugend zu vermitteln
  • Du sprichst fließend deutsch und englisch (jeweils mindestens C1-Niveau)

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem: 

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up-Unternehmen
  • Erfahrung im Medtech-Bereich

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest
  • Eine betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit tollen Zusatzleistungen
  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)
  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth
  • Die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten
  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit) 
  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das einen Monat Elternzeit extra u.v.m. enthält
  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner 
  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine
  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club
  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

  • Recruiter Interview
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Case Study Interview
  • Finales Interview mit dem VP
  • Referenzen

Job Details

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit mit attraktivem Gehaltspaket
  • Arbeitsort Berlin
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice / W

Company Description 
 We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 
 
 We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

 Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

 If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

 With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 
 
 About the role 
 Checkout.com is seeking a Product Manager to join our Payouts Services Product team, based in our London office. The team's mission is to deliver a real-time payouts network to enable our merchants to effectively move money across the globe. Our global merchants already trust us to pay salaries, marketplace sellers, remittances and make crypto-to-fiat payouts.
 You will play a critical role in defining solutions for evolving merchant use cases and expanding geographic coverage, all through a single integration.
 In this role you'll regularly collaborate with other product teams and cross functional stakeholders, acting as champion of our product solution to ensure successful go-to-market.
 
 What you will be doing 
 Defining requirements for product features

 Work with our engineering teams to execute on the delivery of features

 Work with other Checkout.com product teams to define payout use cases whilst ensuring we're planning and delivering together for each other’s products

 Work with cross functional teams such as operations, support, compliance, risk, finance and marketing, ensuring smooth go-to-market

 Working closely with third party providers to ensure they are able to support and deliver the highest level of service that we thrive to provide our merchants

 
 About you 
 4 years of product management experience

 Experience with API-driven products

 Obsession with customer and user experience as drivers of business value

 You seek to validate your assumptions in data

 Great teammate: we're an impactful team that thrive on collaboration

 Ability to build bridges across the organization with high EQ and influencing skills

 Payments or Fintech experience is a plus

 
 Additional Information 
 Bring all of you to work 
 We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.
 Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.
 We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.
 It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.
 
 Life at Checkout.com 
 We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Real Time Operations
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About Axon

Axon’s mission is simple and bold: Protect Life.

We build technology that helps first responders, security teams, and communities act with speed, clarity, and confidence in the moments that matter most. Our Real-Time Operations (RTO) portfolio, anchored by the Fusus platform, is transforming how law enforcement, enterprise security, and international agencies detect, assess, and respond to threats.

Fusus connects live video, alerts, sensors, and location data into a unified operating picture, accessible on any device. Alerts and presence are the heartbeat of that picture. They determine what demands attention and who is in position to act. We're building intelligent, high-signal alerting and presence experiences that cut through noise and keep operators and responders locked into what matters most.

Your Impact

As Senior Product Manager for Alerts & Presence, you will define and lead the roadmap for how Fusus surfaces the right information to the right people at the right time - making alerts and responder presence the connective tissue of real-time operations.

You'll build the systems that determine what warrants attention, how it's prioritized and routed, and how operators maintain awareness of who is where. This spans alert generation from cameras, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party sources, as well as the presence layer that tracks responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity.

Your work will enable officers, security teams, and emergency responders around the world to cut through noise, act on what matters, and coordinate with confidence. By making alerts smarter and presence data seamless, your work will help prevent harm, accelerate response, and directly advance Axon's mission to Protect Life.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Alerts & Presence product roadmap, focused on delivering the right information at the right time to operators and responders
  • Define how alerts are generated, prioritized, routed, and resolved across video, sensors, LPR, drones, and third-party integrations
  • Build presence experiences that give operators real-time visibility into responder locations, unit status, and asset proximity
  • Design fast, intuitive workflows for monitoring incidents, triaging alerts, and coordinating response
  • Partner with engineering and design to ship responsive, low-latency, and reliable alerting and presence features across web and mobile
  • Engage global law enforcement and enterprise users to validate needs and test improvements
  • Align with other product teams to ensure alerts and presence data flow seamlessly across the platform
  • Use metrics and feedback to refine roadmap priorities - reducing alert fatigue, improving time-to-action, and increasing situational awareness
  • Support go-to-market, training, and rollout with cross-functional teams

What Success Looks Like

  • Operators and responders receive timely, high-signal alerts that drive faster, more confident decisions
  • Presence data gives commanders and dispatchers clear visibility into who is where - improving coordination and resource deployment
  • Adoption grows across customer segments with high daily use, strong retention, and positive field feedback
  • Every second saved contributes to safer outcomes for officers, teams, and the public

What You Bring

  • 6–8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years working on real-time, event-driven, or alerting systems
  • Experience building products where speed, clarity, and reliability directly impact outcomes
  • Strong grasp of alerting frameworks, geolocation and presence systems, real-time data pipelines, and notification design
  • Familiarity with live video, sensor networks, LPR, drone telemetry, and IoT integrations
  • Track record of turning user insights into clear product direction and focused execution
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through roadmap, design, delivery, and iteration
  • Clear communicator who drives alignment, decisions, and measurable outcomes

jobs.title: Product Owner, College Pads
jobs.description:
About StarRez


StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

About College Pads 
College Pads is transforming the way students navigate the transition from on-campus to off-campus life. Our platform enables universities to support their students by streamlining the process of finding and securing off-campus housing. By working closely with higher education institutions, we offer a trusted tool for students to connect with property managers and rental listings, helping to foster a foundation for wellbeing and success. As of January 2025, College Pads is part of StarRez.

 
The Role
StarRez is seeking a Product Owner to join the College Pads rebuild team in the UK, helping lead a 0→1 product build through to market launch.

This is not a typical PO role. You’ll be working on a greenfield product with ambitious timelines, high visibility, and real impact, partnering closely with a US-based Product Manager and cross-functional teams in the UK and India. 
 
You’ll play a critical role in translating product vision into execution, driving day-to-day delivery, ensuring the team ships high-quality product at speed and owning the backlog.  

You’ll operate in a fast-moving, AI-first environment, helping the team move quickly, stay aligned, and iterate toward product-market fit and launch readiness. 

Role Details

  • Work Location: Remote (UK) 
  • Travel: 5% (The percentage of travel is an estimation and may vary based on business needs.) 
  • Reporting Structure: This role reports to the Senior Director, Product Engineering. 

 

What You’ll Do 

  • Own delivery from zero to one: Translate product vision into clear, actionable work, owning day-to-day execution, sprint planning, backlog, and launch readiness 
  • Turn strategy into shipped product: Partner closely with the US-based Product Manager to break down priorities into deliverable increments that drive real progress toward launch 
  • Prioritise ruthlessly: Make clear decisions about what matters most, balancing customer value, business impact, speed, scope, and risk 
  • Drive outcomes, not just output: Ensure the team is focused on delivering features that impact acquisition, conversion, engagement, and business outcomes, not just completing tickets 
  • Keep the team moving fast: Remove blockers, clarify requirements, and maintain momentum in a high-urgency environment 
  • Work iteratively: Ship in small increments, gather feedback quickly, and continuously refine based on real usage 
  • Partner with Engineering & Design: Align on scope, trade-offs, and sequencing to balance speed, quality,&nbs
